prompts: Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density. pixel-art game sprite of the real storefront; not resembling any Nintendo / Game Freak / Pokémon asset. Override generic no-text clause: required accurate real brand sign. ONE isolated Tokyo Matsumoto Kiyoshi drugstore, bright yellow horizontal sign with large dark blue マツモトキヨシ lettering exactly, recognizable blue/red brand logo at left. Cream walls, brown trim, glass shopfront showing simple product shelves, glass double entrance right of center. Grey flat roof visible from above. Match palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of attached reference sprites exactly. Logical 112×80 pixels, bold sign large enough to read at that size. Large chunky pixel clusters, minimal detail, transparent background, no ground, no people. Render at least 1024px.
notes: Real brand storefront by art-direction decision (#85); not affiliated. Anchors are zero-based runtime pixel coordinates from top-left. Door marks the threshold; foot marks the bottom-centre sorting point. collisionTiles is the 16px-grid ground footprint of the facade (roof overhang and transparent padding are not collision). Atlas is the artist-finished exact-size sprite: alpha>=128 crop, nearest-neighbour fit, quantized to <=31 colours + transparent, hard alpha. Map owner places a walkable portal in front of the door. Art reviewed at 1x and 3x/6x.
